decisions.decision: Modal background: bg-zinc-800 solid instead of bg-white/5 glassmorphism
decisions.rationale: bg-white/5 on dark #1C1C1E background = nearly transparent, form fields unreadable

decisions.decision: AI prompt uses 'Value' label (no £) to avoid encoding ambiguity
decisions.rationale: Claude haiku may encode or omit the £ sign; normaliseAiLabel() maps 'Value' → 'Value (£)'

decisions.decision: Keyword fallback after AI suggestions: value/worth/market value → Value(£), excludes 'price'
decisions.rationale: Price column = per-share price, not holding value. 'market value' exact match only for market keyword.

decisions.decision: buildPayload only includes name field when non-empty
decisions.rationale: Resilience: if name column migration not run, rows without names still import cleanly (no 42703 error)

decisions.decision: dbError() helper returns Supabase error code 42703 as human-readable schema migration message
decisions.rationale: Generic 'Something went wrong' was hiding the actual cause (missing name column)

decisions.decision: Strip commas from quantity in parseRows (same pattern as value)
decisions.rationale: HL formats 2461.696 as '2,461.696' — NUMERIC cast in Supabase rejects comma-formatted strings
